messages:
Emma K: quick heads-up — hit a weird case in the python sdk while testing transient 500s. client retried and we observed a partial stream chunk duplicated after the retry. not sure if replay logic or streaming buffer.
Raj P: can you paste a minimal repro? was the server sending 500 mid-stream or after close?
Emma K: mid-stream. sequence: stream starts -> chunk A -> connection error 500 -> client retries -> receives A again + B. app saw A twice.
Maria S: oy. we shouldn't silently replay streaming requests unless we have resume semantics. current SDK retries POSTs when idempotency key present; streaming responses aren't rewindable so dupes are expected.
Ben L: transport uses RetryPolicy.retry_if_transient. it may retry at a layer that doesn't know body is streaming. need to stop transparent retries for stream endpoints by default.
Emma K: snippet of my harness:
```
resp = await client.chat_stream(prompt)
async for chunk in resp:
    process(chunk)
# on transport error client retries automatically
```
Raj P: common pattern. options: 1) disable auto-retries for stream endpoints, 2) add resume tokens in protocol, 3) provide replayable_stream helper with checkpoints.
Maria S: UX decision: default should be no transparent retries for streaming. expose opt-in param (e.g., stream_checkpoint=True) that enables checkpoint tokens and allows safe retries. document duplication risk.
Ben L: typing change needed: StreamResponse should expose resume_token and iterator should yield (chunk, token) when checkpoint enabled. update types from AsyncIterator[ChatChunk] -> AsyncIterator[Tuple[ChatChunk, Optional[str]]].
Emma K: propose API:
```
async for chunk, resume_token in client.chat_stream(..., stream_checkpoint=True):
    store(resume_token)
```
and client defaults to not retry network errors for stream endpoints unless stream_checkpoint=True and idempotency key provided.
Maria S: also file an issue about timeout semantics: transport-level timeout raises CancelledError which our retry wrapper treats as terminal. network timeouts should sometimes be retriable.
Ben L: implementation notes: ensure non-streaming POST bodies are rewindable; for streaming provide lightweight checkpointing. add dev-mode lint warning when enable_auto_retry is used with stream=True.
Emma K: can we ship a small sample app showing three patterns: non-streaming retry-safe (idempotency key), streaming-safe (checkpoint + resume), and configuring backoff/timeouts? would help onboarding.
Maria S: I'll open a draft PR to change client signature, add typed aliases, tests, and example under examples/streaming_resume.py.
Ben L: i'll add unit test that injects a 500 mid-stream and asserts duplicate chunk behavior with checkpoint=False and correct resume with True.
infra-bot: created issue #3834: "python-sdk: streaming retries and resume tokens" linking to this thread.
Emma K: thanks — ping me on PR review for the sample app. adding failing test to reproduce locally.
Raj P: will review retry/backoff bits when PR is up.
Maria S: action items: docs + sample app + types + tests. thanks :thumbsup:
